expectations.text: States before drafting any clause that the output will be a draft for review by qualified counsel and not legal advice.
expectations.evidence: The document opens, before any clause: "This will be a draft for review by qualified counsel, not legal advice. Program terms are legally binding on Trellisway and on every affiliate who clicks "I agree.""

expectations.text: Asks by what date the terms must be live before asking about brand-bidding policy or coupon policy.
expectations.evidence: The transcript contains no visible interview turns or question sequence at all — it opens directly with the disclaimer and an assumptions table noting 'a signup date is fixed 19 days out,' giving no evidence that a launch-date question was asked before brand-bidding or coupon questions.

expectations.text: Treats the 19-day launch date as removing the keyword-whitelist and per-partner-tiering brand-bidding positions from the options offered, rather than presenting all four as available.
expectations.evidence: The assumptions table states the default is 'Strict prohibition' because 'Fixed date deletes whitelist/tiering (can't be adjudicated partner-by-partner pre-launch)'.

expectations.text: Cites 25% recurring, the 18-month recurring cap, the $75 threshold and the 45-day validation window as already decided elsewhere.
expectations.evidence: Section 4 states: "This section cites, and does not alter, the commission structure already decided by Trellisway: 1. Rate: 25%... 2. Recurring window: ...18 months... 4. Payout floor: Commission balances below $75..."; the 45-day figure is likewise used consistently (Definitions and Section 15.1) without being flagged as a drafting blank, unlike the bracketed '[X] days' items.

expectations.text: Invents no additional commission rate, tier, or payout threshold figure anywhere in the draft.
expectations.evidence: Section 16.2 introduces a new figure not present among the given facts: "add a withheld-percentage reserve (10–15% released quarterly is the common band) via the amendment process in Section 17."

expectations.text: Marks the EU Platform-to-Business applicability question with [LEGAL REVIEW] instead of asserting that P2B does or does not reach an in-house merchant program.
expectations.evidence: The document flags this with "[LEGAL REVIEW: EU Platform-to-Business Regulation (EU) 2019/1150 in-scope question...This is not certain — if any Customer segment turns out to include consumers, or if a regulator reads the affiliate relationship differently, P2B's ... rules would bind" rather than asserting a definitive answer.

expectations.text: Places each [LEGAL REVIEW: <reason>] marker inline next to the clause it concerns, not pooled in a footer or closing list.
expectations.evidence: Markers appear directly inside their clauses, e.g. Section 6.1's "[LEGAL REVIEW: contractual only — search engines will not enforce this...]" and Section 9.2's "[LEGAL REVIEW: GDPR role allocation]" sit immediately next to the relevant text rather than being deferred solely to the end.

expectations.text: Marks the governing-law/arbitration clause, the unilateral-amendment clause, and the trademark-bidding ban with [LEGAL REVIEW].
expectations.evidence: Section 19 and Section 6.1 each carry a [LEGAL REVIEW] marker, but Section 17 (Amendment) — "Trellisway may amend these Terms by posting an updated version...At least 15 days' notice..." — has no [LEGAL REVIEW] marker anywhere in its text.

expectations.text: Includes a clause stating what happens to earned-but-unpaid commissions at termination.
expectations.evidence: Section 14 'Effect of Termination on Pending Commissions' states: "Non-fraud termination...Trellisway pays all Commissions validly earned up to the termination date..." and "Fraud or for-cause termination: Commissions attributable to the violating conduct are forfeited. Commissions earned through unrelated, legitimate activity are still paid."

expectations.text: Includes automatic revocation of the brand-asset licence on any termination, with a fixed asset-destruction window.
expectations.evidence: Section 3.3: "This licence terminates automatically and immediately on termination of this Agreement for any reason — no separate notice required. The former Affiliate must remove and destroy all brand assets and cease all use of Trellisway's marks within 5 business days."
